{{Quote|You ''knew'' that I distrust the Jedi, Chancellor. Now my guardian is dead, and by one of your own sentries.|Baroness Omnino|<ref name="Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell 1">[[Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell 1|''Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell'' 1]]</ref>}}
An '''individual''' served as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] to [[Baroness/Legends|Baroness]] [[Omnino]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Vena]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Unidentified Senate Guard (mind control)|Senate Guard]] in [[37 BBY/Legends|37 BBY]] while accompanying Omnino to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] was actually under the influence of a [[mind control device]] as part of the Baroness's convoluted plot to discredit the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and eat some [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Mantellian Savrips]].
